name: Variations as Radio Buttons
author: WPXtension

sections.description:
Variations as Radio Buttons is a WooCommerce extension that transforms the default WooCommerce Variable Product drop-downs into radio buttons. As a result, it improves your store’s UX by making the variable product selection process easier and more intuitive.

It offers a plug-and-play feature, and all product attributes on your store will turn into radio buttons (for example, Color, Size, etc.).

Key Features:
– Cleanly replaces dropdowns with radio buttons on product pages.
– Fully accessible and compatible with most themes.
– Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce’s variation logic.
– Requires no settings — just activate and go!

Use Case Examples:
– Replace “Choose an option” dropdowns with radio buttons.
– Great for small sets of options (e.g., S / M / L or Red / Blue / Green).
– Ideal for fashion stores, custom products, and simple UX-focused shops.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Visit any WooCommerce variable product page — your dropdowns will now be radio buttons!

No settings to configure. It just works!
sections.faq:
Will this work with any theme?

Yes, it should work with any theme that follows WooCommerce standards. Custom-styled themes may require minor CSS tweaks.

Can I style the radio buttons?

Yes! Just target .rvwoo-radio-variation in your CSS. You can customize the layout, spacing, and labels however you like.

Does it support multiple variation attributes?

Yes. Each variation attribute will be displayed as a separate group of radio buttons.

What happens if there are many options (e.g., 50 colors)?

Radio buttons are best for small to moderate sets. If your attribute has too many values, consider keeping the dropdown for better UX.
